subject: Upper limit on R/qtl loci and individuals?

messages.author: f6cab08c66980fab
messages.subject: Upper limit on R/qtl loci and individuals?
parts: Is there a limit on the number of loci or individuals for R/qtl2? I have a fairly large data set (32K loci, 200 individuals) but unfortunately only R/qtl or possibly R/qtl2 has the function I'm looking for. Regular GWAS systems don't include it.

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] Upper limit on R/qtl loci and individuals?
parts:
There's no hard limit on the number of individuals or markers. You may have problems managing memory, but it should be okay.

karl
